description: Focus transitions as the server applies them: a state (tasks and sessions of one user in one list), one action, and the result. The backend tests (backend-node/test/services/focus-transitions.test.ts) run every case against the server; the frontend optimistic transition (frontend/src/lib/focus/optimistic.ts) reads the same cases. Plain data: no code is needed to read it.

conventions.times: Every time is in minutes after t0 (fractions allowed). t0 is 10:00 in the workspace timezone, so every case happens on one local day.
conventions.tasks: given.tasks lists the tasks of the list in board order; key names a task in the case and in the expected results. column defaults to today, estimate_minutes to null, completed_at to null (a done task gives it).
conventions.sessions: Sessions of the user, oldest first. task is a task key, or null for a break. Defaults: kind task (break when task is null), device A, ended_at, end_reason, deadline_at and planned_seconds null, last_seen_at equal to started_at.
conventions.given.state: What GET /api/focus answers at action.at before the action. That read settles the due sessions (AD-001), which given.sessions does not show and expect.sessions does.
conventions.action: type is the route after /api/focus/ (start, pause, skip, complete, extend, break, break/end, heartbeat, recover). at is occurred_at; received_at (default at) is when the server receives it, the now of the response. heartbeat has no occurred_at: its at is when the server receives it. device defaults to A. The other fields are the payload: task (a key), takeover, minutes, decision; break uses the case's list.
conventions.expect: status is the HTTP status; code the error code of a 409 or 422. sessions is every session after the action, oldest first. tasks, when present, is every task after the action in board order (columns backlog, this_week, today, done; position inside each); when absent the tasks did not change. state is the 200 response at received_at.
conventions.state: session: the open session (task key, kind, device, started_at, deadline_at, planned_seconds) or null. task: the task in focus or the first pending task of Today (key, spent_seconds, awaiting_extend) or null. today: pending tasks, tasks completed today, the estimate sum of the pending ones and tasks, the pending tasks of Today in board order (key, spent_seconds, awaiting_extend; title and estimate are the task's, position is checked by the order). stale: the open session when it has had no signal for more than 120 s (last_seen_at, seconds) or null.

cases.name: start on the first task of Today opens a session whose deadline is the whole estimate
start after a pause resumes from the time already spent: deadline = start + (estimate - spent)
start on a task without estimate opens a session without deadline
start on a task whose estimate is used up and awaits extend opens no session
requirements: Edge: spent equals the estimate when the focus opens

cases.name: start after an extended session was paused counts up without deadline
start with a session open on another device answers focus_elsewhere and opens nothing
takeover on the same task keeps the session without cutting it and moves it to this device
takeover on another task ends the old session and opens the new one at the same instant
start on the task already counting on this device keeps its session
start on another task from the same device switches the session at the same instant
start during a break on this device answers invalid_transition
start on a task outside Today answers invalid_transition
start on a task already done answers invalid_transition
pause ends the task session at the click and keeps the time spent
pause the task counting on another device ends it too
pause sent offline and received after the deadline applies at the time of the click
pause after the deadline answers invalid_transition: the estimate already ended the session
pause without an open session answers invalid_transition
pause during a break answers invalid_transition
skip ends the session, moves the task to the end of Today and starts the next one
skip while paused moves the task to the end of Today and starts the next one
skip with a single pending task in Today answers invalid_transition
skip a task other than the one counting answers invalid_transition
complete ends the session, moves the task to done at the click and starts the next one
complete the last pending task of Today leaves no session and no task
complete a task awaiting extend moves it to done and starts the next one
complete a task already done answers invalid_transition and keeps its completed_at
complete during a break answers invalid_transition
extend opens a session without deadline that counts up from the estimate
extend a task that does not await extend answers invalid_transition
extend while the task is counting answers invalid_transition
extend a task without estimate answers invalid_transition
break while a task counts ends the task session and opens a break whose deadline is its end
break while paused opens a break
break during a break answers invalid_transition
a break past its deadline ended exactly at its planned length and the task stays paused until start
break/end before the end ends the break with the time that passed and leaves the task paused
break/end without a break answers invalid_transition
heartbeat records the last signal of the session of this device
heartbeat from another device leaves the session alone and answers invalid_transition
heartbeat without an open session answers invalid_transition
recover keep records a fresh signal and keeps the session counting
recover cut with the last signal at 10:00 ends the session at 10:00
recover on a session with a recent signal answers invalid_transition
recover without an open session answers invalid_transition
